paragraphs: The XJ 3.0d was introduced in the X351 generation, produced from 2009 to 2019. It uses the AJD-V6 — a 3.0-litre V6 diesel engine, Ford-sourced with twin-turbocharging. The XJ 3.0d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road. about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJD-V6 engines for every XJ 3.0d on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the XJ 3.0d from 2023 to present. The AJD-V6 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older AJD-V6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJD-V6 rebuild.
